cards.name: Kalfu
cards.line: He had been running for six hours. This was where the running ended.

cards.name: The Girl with the Lamp
cards.line: You’re late. I wasn’t waiting. I was studying.

cards.name: The Seven in Grey
cards.line: They watched. They only had to wait.

cards.name: The Last Floor
cards.line: Above him there was nothing but sky.

cards.name: Still Water
cards.line: A city, with the water already in it.

cards.name: The Lit Door
cards.line: It was the only thing in the whole bright city that cast a shadow.
